{
  "attribution": "This product contains data sourced from EPO databases, © European Patent Organisation",
  "data_edition": "PATSTAT 2026 Spring",
  "examples": [
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT a.office, a.filing_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.application_id) AS applications,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.granted THEN a.application_id END) AS granted
FROM flowleap.applications a
JOIN flowleap.applicants ap ON ap.application_id = a.application_id
WHERE UPPER(ap.name) LIKE 'SIEMENS%'
  AND a.filing_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 AND a.ipr_type = 'PI'
GROUP BY a.office, a.filing_year
ORDER BY a.filing_year, applications DESC
",
      "promoted_to": "POST /v1/patstat/portfolio (Layer 1, shipped)",
      "question": "Show me {applicant}'s worldwide patent filing activity by year and office."
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT ap.name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.family_id) AS families,
       MIN(a.earliest_filing_year) AS active_since
FROM flowleap.classifications c
JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = c.application_id
JOIN flowleap.applicants ap  ON ap.application_id = a.application_id
WHERE c.cpc_code LIKE 'H01M10/0562%' AND a.earliest_filing_year >= 2015
GROUP BY ap.name ORDER BY families DESC LIMIT 15
",
      "promoted_to": "planned: POST /v1/patstat/landscape",
      "question": "Who dominates {technology_area}? (top applicants by invention count)"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT a.earliest_filing_year AS filing_year, a.office,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.family_id) AS families
FROM flowleap.classifications c
JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = c.application_id
WHERE c.cpc_code LIKE 'H01M10/056%'
  AND a.earliest_filing_year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2025
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC
",
      "promoted_to": "planned: POST /v1/patstat/trends",
      "question": "How fast is {technology_area} growing, and in which offices?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH fam AS (
  SELECT a.family_id, MAX(a.citing_families) AS citing_families_attr
  FROM flowleap.publications p
  JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = p.application_id
  WHERE p.office = 'EP' AND p.number = '2771468'
  GROUP BY a.family_id)
SELECT f.family_id, f.citing_families_attr,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fc.citing_family_id) AS citing_families_counted
FROM fam f LEFT JOIN flowleap.family_citations fc ON fc.cited_family_id = f.family_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
",
      "promoted_to": "planned: POST /v1/patstat/citations",
      "question": "How influential is the {publication} patent family?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS citing_documents,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.is_x) AS x_cited,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.is_y) AS y_cited,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.is_a) AS a_cited,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.categories IS NULL) AS uncategorized,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.origins LIKE '%SEA%' OR cr.origins LIKE '%ISR%'
                           OR cr.origins LIKE '%SUP%' OR cr.origins LIKE '%EXA%'
                           OR cr.origins LIKE '%PRS%') AS examiner_found
FROM flowleap.citations_received cr
JOIN flowleap.publications fp ON fp.publication_id = cr.cited_publication_id
WHERE fp.application_id IN (
  SELECT fm.application_id
  FROM flowleap.family_members fm
  WHERE fm.family_id = (
    SELECT a.family_id
    FROM flowleap.publications p
    JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = p.application_id
    WHERE p.office = 'EP' AND p.number = '2771468'
    LIMIT 1))
",
      "question": "How often is {publication}'s family cited as novelty-destroying (X) or inventive-step (Y) art?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT fm.office, COUNT(DISTINCT fm.application_id) AS applications,
       MIN(fm.filing_date) AS first_filing,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fm.granted THEN fm.application_id END) AS granted
FROM flowleap.publications p
JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = p.application_id
JOIN flowleap.family_members fm ON fm.family_id = a.family_id
WHERE p.office = 'EP' AND p.number = '2771468'
GROUP BY fm.office ORDER BY applications DESC
",
      "promoted_to": "planned: POST /v1/patstat/family",
      "question": "Where is the {publication} invention protected?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT le.event_office, le.event_code, COUNT(*) AS occurrences,
       MIN(le.event_date) AS first_seen, MAX(le.event_date) AS last_seen
FROM flowleap.legal_events le
WHERE le.application_id = (
  SELECT p.application_id
  FROM flowleap.publications p
  WHERE p.office = 'EP' AND p.number = '2771468'
  LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY first_seen
",
      "question": "What happened legally to {publication}?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT tf.sector, tf.field, COUNT(DISTINCT a.family_id) AS families
FROM flowleap.applications a
JOIN flowleap.applicants ap ON ap.application_id = a.application_id
JOIN flowleap.tech_fields tf ON tf.application_id = a.application_id
WHERE UPPER(ap.name) LIKE 'SIEMENS%' AND a.filing_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY families DESC LIMIT 10
",
      "question": "What technology fields is {applicant} active in?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT i.name AS inventor, COUNT(DISTINCT a.family_id) AS families
FROM flowleap.applications a
JOIN flowleap.applicants ap ON ap.application_id = a.application_id
JOIN flowleap.inventors i   ON i.application_id = a.application_id
WHERE UPPER(ap.name) LIKE 'SIEMENS%' AND a.filing_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024
GROUP BY i.name ORDER BY families DESC LIMIT 10
",
      "question": "Who are {applicant}'s most prolific inventors on filings from {year} to {year}?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT symbol, level, title
FROM flowleap.cpc_scheme
WHERE title ILIKE '%photovoltaic%' AND (level IS NULL OR level = 0)
ORDER BY symbol LIMIT 20
",
      "question": "Which CPC codes cover {technology_term}? (verify/find codes before landscaping)"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT a.office, COUNT(DISTINCT a.application_id) AS applications,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.granted THEN a.application_id END)
                   / COUNT(DISTINCT a.application_id), 1) AS grant_rate_pct
FROM flowleap.classifications c
JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = c.application_id
WHERE c.cpc_code LIKE 'H01M10/056%'
  AND a.filing_year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018 AND a.ipr_type = 'PI'
  AND a.office <> 'WO'
GROUP BY a.office HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.application_id) >= 100
ORDER BY grant_rate_pct DESC
",
      "question": "Where is it easiest to get a {technology_area} patent granted?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT 'priority'::text AS relation, pr.priority_seq AS seq,
       anc.application_id, anc.office, anc.filing_date, anc.granted
FROM flowleap.priorities pr
JOIN flowleap.applications anc ON anc.application_id = pr.priority_application_id
WHERE pr.application_id = 414237564
UNION ALL
SELECT co.link_kind, NULL::smallint, anc.application_id, anc.office, anc.filing_date, anc.granted
FROM flowleap.continuations co
JOIN flowleap.applications anc ON anc.application_id = co.parent_application_id
WHERE co.application_id = 414237564
ORDER BY 5, 2
",
      "question": "What does {application} claim priority from, and what is it a continuation or divisional of?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH hop1 AS (
  SELECT pr.application_id, 'priority'::text AS link
  FROM flowleap.priorities pr
  WHERE pr.priority_application_id = 905384508
  UNION
  SELECT co.application_id, co.link_kind
  FROM flowleap.continuations co
  WHERE co.parent_application_id = 905384508
), hop2 AS (
  SELECT pr.application_id, 'priority'::text AS link
  FROM flowleap.priorities pr
  JOIN hop1 h ON h.application_id = pr.priority_application_id
  UNION
  SELECT co.application_id, co.link_kind
  FROM flowleap.continuations co
  JOIN hop1 h ON h.application_id = co.parent_application_id
), descent AS (
  SELECT e.application_id,
         MIN(e.hop) AS hop,
         string_agg(DISTINCT e.link, ',' ORDER BY e.link) AS reached_via
  FROM (SELECT application_id, link, 1 AS hop FROM hop1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT application_id, link, 2 AS hop FROM hop2) e
  GROUP BY e.application_id
)
SELECT d.hop, d.reached_via, a.office,
       COUNT(*) AS applications,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.family_id) AS families
FROM descent d
JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = d.application_id
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 4 DESC
",
      "question": "What has descended from {application} — everything claiming priority from it or continuing it — within 2 hops?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT ap.name AS applicant, a.filing_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.application_id) AS applications,
       COUNT(DISTINCT co.application_id) AS divisionals,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT co.application_id)
                   / COUNT(DISTINCT a.application_id), 1) AS divisional_share_pct
FROM flowleap.classifications c
JOIN flowleap.applications a  ON a.application_id = c.application_id
JOIN flowleap.applicants ap   ON ap.application_id = a.application_id
LEFT JOIN flowleap.continuations co
       ON co.application_id = a.application_id AND co.link_kind = 'divisional'
WHERE c.cpc_code LIKE 'H01M10/056%'
  AND a.filing_year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2022
  AND a.ipr_type = 'PI'
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.application_id) >= 20
ORDER BY divisional_share_pct DESC, applications DESC
",
      "question": "Who files the most divisionals in {technology_area}, as a share of their filings, by year?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT c.code, c.description, c.category, c.category_title
FROM flowleap.legal_event_codes c
WHERE c.office = 'EP'
  AND c.description ILIKE '%opposition%'
ORDER BY c.category NULLS LAST, c.code
",
      "question": "Which {office} legal-event codes mean {concept}?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH grants AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.application_id
  FROM flowleap.applications a
  JOIN flowleap.applicants ap ON ap.application_id = a.application_id
  WHERE UPPER(ap.name) LIKE 'BASF%' AND a.office = 'EP' AND a.granted
    AND a.filing_year >= 2000
), opposed AS (
  SELECT le.application_id,
         MIN(le.event_date) AS first_opposition_date,
         COUNT(*)           AS opposition_event_rows
  FROM grants g
  JOIN flowleap.legal_events le ON le.application_id = g.application_id
  WHERE le.event_office = 'EP'
    AND le.event_code IN ('26', 'PLBI', 'R26')
    AND le.event_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY le.application_id
)
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.first_opposition_date)::int AS opposition_year,
       COUNT(*)                       AS grants_opposed,
       SUM(o.opposition_event_rows)   AS event_rows
FROM opposed o
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
",
      "question": "How many of {applicant}'s EP grants filed since {year} were opposed, by year?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH grants AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.application_id
  FROM flowleap.applications a
  JOIN flowleap.applicants ap ON ap.application_id = a.application_id
  WHERE UPPER(ap.name) LIKE 'BAYER%'
    AND a.office = 'EP' AND a.granted
    AND a.filing_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2015
)
SELECT le.lapse_country,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM le.lapse_date)::int      AS lapse_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT le.application_id)          AS patents_lapsed
FROM grants g
JOIN flowleap.legal_events le ON le.application_id = g.application_id
WHERE le.event_office = 'EP'
  AND le.event_code IN ('PG25', 'VS25')
  AND le.lapse_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC
",
      "question": "In which states does {applicant} let its EP patents lapse, and when?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH hits AS (
  SELECT tx.application_id
  FROM flowleap.application_texts tx
  WHERE to_tsvector('english', tx.title) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'solid state battery electrolyte')
    AND tx.title_lang = 'en'
), scoped AS (
  SELECT h.application_id, a.family_id
  FROM hits h
  JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = h.application_id
  WHERE a.ipr_type = 'PI' AND a.earliest_filing_year >= 2015
), codes AS (
  SELECT LEFT(c.cpc_code, 4) AS cpc_subclass,
         c.cpc_code,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.family_id)      AS families,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.application_id) AS applications
  FROM scoped s
  JOIN flowleap.classifications c ON c.application_id = s.application_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT k.cpc_subclass, k.cpc_code, k.families, k.applications,
       ROUND(100.0 * k.families / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT family_id) FROM scoped), 1) AS share_of_hits_pct,
       sub.title AS subclass_title, grp.title AS code_title
FROM codes k
LEFT JOIN flowleap.cpc_scheme sub ON sub.symbol = k.cpc_subclass
LEFT JOIN flowleap.cpc_scheme grp ON grp.symbol = k.cpc_code
ORDER BY k.families DESC, k.cpc_code
LIMIT 30
",
      "question": "Which CPC codes dominate {concept} filings? (derive the codes from the corpus, not from a table)"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH hits AS (
  SELECT tx.application_id
  FROM flowleap.application_texts tx
  WHERE to_tsvector('english', tx.abstract) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'solid state battery electrolyte')
    AND tx.abstract_lang = 'en'
), scoped AS (
  SELECT h.application_id, a.family_id
  FROM hits h
  JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = h.application_id
  WHERE a.ipr_type = 'PI' AND a.earliest_filing_year >= 2015
), codes AS (
  SELECT LEFT(c.cpc_code, 4) AS cpc_subclass,
         c.cpc_code,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.family_id)      AS families,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.application_id) AS applications
  FROM scoped s
  JOIN flowleap.classifications c ON c.application_id = s.application_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT k.cpc_subclass, k.cpc_code, k.families, k.applications,
       ROUND(100.0 * k.families / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT family_id) FROM scoped), 1) AS share_of_hits_pct,
       sub.title AS subclass_title, grp.title AS code_title
FROM codes k
LEFT JOIN flowleap.cpc_scheme sub ON sub.symbol = k.cpc_subclass
LEFT JOIN flowleap.cpc_scheme grp ON grp.symbol = k.cpc_code
ORDER BY k.families DESC, k.cpc_code
LIMIT 30
",
      "question": "Which CPC codes dominate {concept} filings, matching the ABSTRACT for recall rather than the title for precision?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH hits AS (
  SELECT tx.application_id
  FROM flowleap.application_texts tx
  WHERE to_tsvector('english', tx.title) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'solid state battery electrolyte')
    AND tx.title_lang = 'en'
), scoped AS (
  SELECT h.application_id, a.family_id, a.office
  FROM hits h
  JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = h.application_id
  WHERE a.ipr_type = 'PI' AND a.earliest_filing_year >= 2015
)
SELECT ap.name AS applicant,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.family_id)      AS families,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.application_id) AS applications,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.office)         AS offices
FROM scoped s
JOIN flowleap.applicants ap ON ap.application_id = s.application_id
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.family_id) >= 5
ORDER BY families DESC, applicant
LIMIT 25
",
      "question": "Who are the top applicants for {concept} since {year}?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT inpadoc_family_id
  FROM flowleap.inpadoc_family_members
  WHERE application_id = 16277555
)
SELECT m.office,
       COUNT(*)                          AS members,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.granted) AS granted_members,
       MIN(m.filing_date)                AS earliest_filing
FROM anchor a
JOIN flowleap.inpadoc_family_members m ON m.inpadoc_family_id = a.inpadoc_family_id
GROUP BY m.office
ORDER BY members DESC, m.office
",
      "promoted_to": "none",
      "question": "Where is the extended family of {application} alive — which offices, and how many of those members are granted?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT inpadoc_family_id
  FROM flowleap.inpadoc_family_members
  WHERE application_id = 16277555
)
SELECT COUNT(*)                     AS extended_members,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fm.family_id) AS docdb_families_inside,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.office)     AS offices
FROM anchor a
JOIN flowleap.inpadoc_family_members m ON m.inpadoc_family_id = a.inpadoc_family_id
JOIN flowleap.family_members fm        ON fm.application_id = m.application_id
",
      "promoted_to": "none",
      "question": "How much wider is the extended family of {application} than its simple family — is it safe to count inventions over it?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT ipc.ipc_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.family_id)      AS families,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.application_id) AS applications
FROM flowleap.applicants ap
JOIN flowleap.applications a          ON a.application_id = ap.application_id
JOIN flowleap.ipc_classifications ipc ON ipc.application_id = a.application_id
WHERE UPPER(ap.name) LIKE 'ROBERT BOSCH%'
  AND a.ipr_type = 'PI'
  AND a.filing_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024
  AND ipc.ipc_value = 'invention'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY families DESC, ipc.ipc_code
LIMIT 25
",
      "promoted_to": "none",
      "question": "What technology does {applicant} file in, by IPC group?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "SELECT a.filing_year, a.office,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.family_id) AS families
FROM flowleap.ipc_classifications ipc
JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = ipc.application_id
WHERE ipc.ipc_code LIKE 'H01M10/056%'
  AND a.ipr_type = 'PI'
  AND a.filing_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC
LIMIT 5000
",
      "promoted_to": "none",
      "question": "IPC landscape for {ipc_prefix} by year and office."
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH corpus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.application_id
  FROM flowleap.applicants ap
  JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = ap.application_id
  WHERE UPPER(ap.name) LIKE 'ROBERT BOSCH%'
    AND a.ipr_type = 'PI'
    AND a.filing_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2024
)
SELECT s.nace_code, s.nace_title,
       ROUND(SUM(s.weight), 1) AS weighted_applications,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.weight) / SUM(SUM(s.weight)) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct
FROM corpus c
JOIN flowleap.sectors s ON s.application_id = c.application_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY weighted_applications DESC
LIMIT 15
",
      "promoted_to": "none",
      "question": "Which industry sectors does {applicant} file in from {year} to {year}, and in what proportion?"
    },
    {
      "logical_sql": "WITH corpus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.application_id
  FROM flowleap.classifications c
  JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = c.application_id
  WHERE c.cpc_code LIKE 'H01M10/0562%'
    AND a.ipr_type = 'PI'
    AND a.earliest_filing_year >= 2015
)
SELECT s.nace_code, s.nace_title,
       ROUND(SUM(s.weight), 1) AS weighted_applications,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.weight) / SUM(SUM(s.weight)) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct
FROM corpus c
JOIN flowleap.sectors s ON s.application_id = c.application_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY weighted_applications DESC
LIMIT 12

WITH hits AS (
  SELECT tx.application_id
  FROM flowleap.application_texts tx
  WHERE to_tsvector('english', tx.title) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'perovskite tandem')
    AND tx.title_lang = 'en'
), scoped AS (
  SELECT h.application_id, a.family_id
  FROM hits h
  JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = h.application_id
  WHERE a.ipr_type = 'PI' AND a.earliest_filing_year >= 2012
), codes AS (
  SELECT LEFT(c.cpc_code, 4) AS cpc_subclass,
         c.cpc_code,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.family_id)      AS families,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.application_id) AS applications
  FROM scoped s
  JOIN flowleap.classifications c ON c.application_id = s.application_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT k.cpc_subclass, k.cpc_code, k.families, k.applications,
       ROUND(100.0 * k.families / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT family_id) FROM scoped), 1) AS share_of_hits_pct,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT family_id) FROM scoped) AS total_families,
       grp.title AS code_title
FROM codes k
LEFT JOIN flowleap.cpc_scheme grp ON grp.symbol = k.cpc_code
ORDER BY k.families DESC, k.cpc_code
LIMIT 30

input.question: Which CPC codes do 'perovskite tandem cell' filings actually use? (abstract match, for recall)
input.sql:
WITH hits AS (
  SELECT tx.application_id
  FROM flowleap.application_texts tx
  WHERE to_tsvector('english', tx.abstract) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'perovskite tandem solar cell')
    AND tx.abstract_lang = 'en'
), scoped AS (
  SELECT h.application_id, a.family_id
  FROM hits h
  JOIN flowleap.applications a ON a.application_id = h.application_id
  WHERE a.ipr_type = 'PI' AND a.earliest_filing_year >= 2012
), codes AS (
  SELECT LEFT(c.cpc_code, 4) AS cpc_subclass,
         c.cpc_code,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.family_id)      AS families,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.application_id) AS applications
  FROM scoped s
  JOIN flowleap.classifications c ON c.application_id = s.application_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT k.cpc_subclass, k.cpc_code, k.families, k.applications,
       ROUND(100.0 * k.families / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT family_id) FROM scoped), 1) AS share_of_hits_pct,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT family_id) FROM scoped) AS total_families,
       grp.title AS code_title
FROM codes k
LEFT JOIN flowleap.cpc_scheme grp ON grp.symbol = k.cpc_code
ORDER BY k.families DESC, k.cpc_code
LIMIT 30

The answer comes from the PATSTAT 2026 Spring edition, derived from the corpus itself: I took every English-language family whose title (65 families) or abstract (132 families) contains "perovskite tandem [solar cell]", and counted the CPC codes actually assigned to them. Both cuts rank the same core set.

**Core codes on roughly half or more of families**

| CPC code | Meaning | Share of families (abstract cut) |
|---|---|---|
| Y02E10/549 | Organic PV cells (climate tag applied to perovskite PV) | 66% |
| H10K30/57 | Organic/hybrid PV comprising multiple junctions, e.g. tandem PV cells | 50% |
| H10K85/50 | Hybrid organic-inorganic perovskite materials, e.g. CH3NH3PbI3 | 50% |
| H10K30/40 | p-i-n structure with perovskite absorber between transport layers | 33% |

**Second tier, on 15 to 30% of families**

- H10F10/19 (multi-barrier PV cells of different types, e.g. tandem with PN and PIN junctions). This is the main inorganic-side tandem code and the strongest signal for perovskite-on-silicon.
- H10K39/15 (devices combining organic and inorganic PV cells).
- H10K30/10 (heterojunctions between organic and inorganic semiconductors).
- H10F10/161 and H10F10/142 (multiple PN heterojunctions or homojunctions, e.g. tandem cells).
- H10K30/50 (organic/hybrid PV devices generally), Y02P70/50 (manufacturing tag), H10F71/00 (manufacture of inorganic PV).

**Feature codes that recur on 8 to 17% of families** cover the usual tandem sub-problems: transparent electrodes and recombination layers (H10K30/82, H10F77/244), textured surfaces (H10F77/703, H10F77/707), passivation and encapsulation (H10K30/88), transport layers (H10K30/85, H10K30/86), light trapping (H10K30/87), mechanically stacked four-terminal cells (H10F19/40), and solution processing (H10K71/12).

**Practical notes for building a search**

- H10K and H10F are the reclassified successors of H01L51 and H01L31. Filings published before 2023 to 2025 may still carry legacy codes such as H01L31/0725, H01L31/078 and H01L51/42, so include those for back-file recall.
- A small tail sits in H01G9/2009 and Y02E10/542, which are dye-sensitized-cell codes inherited from early perovskite work. Include them only if you want pre-2016 material.
- A tight query is H10K30/57 OR H10F10/19 combined with H10K85/50. That intersection captures the "perovskite" and the "tandem" concepts by classification alone. Adding Y02E10/549 alone is too broad, since it tags all organic PV.

The Google Patents slice dated 2026-07-07 agrees at subclass level: H10K dominates, followed by H10F, Y02E, H01G and legacy H01L. Top filers on the exact phrase are Hanwha Solutions, CubicPV, UNC Chapel Hill, Tongwei and Hiking PV.
